species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 47°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–34 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 75 ft, so fish stay above it.
